- Stopping rules:
    - Bayes factor threshold set to 10
    - Minimum sample size = 40, maximum sample size = 80
- **Key research hypothesis**: There is an interaction between association type and task type. This critical hypothesized effect determines when to terminate data collection in the present study.
- Only the interaction effect will be tested here.


```{r}
rm(list = ls())
```

Download and install required R packages

```{r message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
# install.packages(c("tidyverse", "BayesFactor", "here"))
library(BayesFactor) # Compute Bayes factors for t‑tests and ANOVA
packageVersion("BayesFactor")
library(tidyverse)
library(showtext)
library(latex2exp) # latex
showtext_auto()
library(here)
here()
options(scipen = 9)
set.seed(1234)
```

Load custom functions

```{r}
source(here::here("Functions/Function_bf_avo.R"))
source(here::here("Functions/Function_plot_avo.R"))
```

## Read cleaned data

```{r}
# Adjust file paths and filenames according to real‑world conditions
# Set relative path for target folder
folder_path <- "../../3_Data/3_2_exp2/CleanData"

# List target files
file_list <- list.files(
  path = folder_path,
  pattern = "*df_.*\\.csv$", full.names = TRUE
)

# Initialize a list to store data frames
df_list <- list()
for (i in seq_along(file_list)) {
  df_name <- tools::file_path_sans_ext(file_list[i])
  df_list[[df_name]] <- read.csv(file_list[i])
}
```


## Bayes factor calculation

```{r}
data_sbfa <- data_sbfa %>% 
  dplyr::mutate(subj_idx = as.factor(subj_idx))
```


### ACC

```{r}
bfs_acc <- bf_aov(data_sbfa, 'acc')

bfs_acc
```

**Visualization**

```{r}
plot_bfs_association <- plot_aov(bfs_acc, 'bfs_association', 'Association effect (ACC)')
plot_bfs_association

plot_bfs_int <- plot_aov(bfs_acc, 'bfs_int', 'Interaction (ACC)')
plot_bfs_int
```

#### RT

```{r}
bfs_rt <- bf_aov(data_sbfa, 'rt')

bfs_rt
```

**Visualization**

```{r}
plot_bfs_association <- plot_aov(bfs_rt, 'bfs_association', 'Association effect (RT)')
plot_bfs_association

plot_bfs_int <- plot_aov(bfs_rt, 'bfs_int', 'Interaction (RT)')
plot_bfs_int
```



**End**
